_comment: Portable PostHog export of created entities (NOT raw event/person data). Generated via the PostHog MCP. Re-import into a different org/account by following README.md. IDs are NOT preserved — entities are re-created and cross-references (dashboard<->insight) are rebuilt by name at import time.
notes: Insights flagged "starter": true are PostHog's auto-generated starter insights/dashboard. A fresh project creates its own copies, so importing them will DUPLICATE. Skip unless you specifically want them.
Raw collected data (events, persons, sessions) is NOT portable and is not included — it re-accumulates once the SDK points at the new project.
Insight queries reference events by NAME (e.g. order_completed, chat_opened). They keep working in the new project as soon as those events are ingested.
import order: cohorts -> dashboards -> insights (insights attach to dashboards by name via the new dashboard id).
